kind: unofficial modified TypeScript coding-agent source mirror

runtime.execution: Bun/Node async generators and React/Ink; in-process teammate loops, shell children and remote-session client.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local turn/task/transcript state; consumes model/MCP/remote sessions. Artifact authenticity and correspondence to official executable unverified.

summary: A rich but incomplete, modified unofficial source artifact: real query/tool/teammate code, gated or missing internals, and selective transcripts. Its behavior is not attributed to official Claude Code.

inspection.scope: Read mirror provenance, actual query/dependency wiring, tool registry/dispatch/edit/shell, teammate mailbox and runner, compaction/transcript, configuration/permission and remote controls, plus web session test.
inspection.limits: No execution; authenticity unverified. WorkflowTool/REPLTool core modules referenced by gated registry absent in acquired tree; issue command is disabled stub. Many internal build gates and dependencies unavailable.

actions.name: Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep/NotebookEdit
actions.input: file paths, ranges, replacement text/search patterns
actions.lifecycle: tool rounds; Edit stale-read check before synchronous write

actions.name: Bash / background task / TaskOutput / TaskStop
actions.output: progress, transformed merged output, task handles
actions.lifecycle: foreground awaited or background owned task; active-frame/child settlement not fully traced
actions.authority: model permitted shell; scope per-agent tasks

actions.name: Agent / team / SendMessage
actions.input: prompt/model override, peer or * and message
actions.output: independent peer task, mailbox receipt or shutdown protocol
actions.lifecycle: peer works independently, returns idle and polls; busy delivery boundary not fully traced
actions.authority: model registry with feature/build gates; write failures can still report sent

actions.name: Compact / MCP refresh / queued steering
actions.input: custom summary instructions, queued agent-addressed messages, connected MCP tools
actions.lifecycle: context preparation each provider round; slash commands after turn
actions.authority: host callbacks and operator control, not arbitrary model-authored scheduler

actions.name: Config get/set
actions.lifecycle: specific state updates immediate; query config snapshot and MCP next round differ

actions.name: Remote session message/interrupt/reconnect
actions.output: send success, WS controls, reconnected transport
actions.lifecycle: HTTP + WS client; no direct OS execution in this path

filesystem.detail: Native edit/read/search/write/notebook tools; stale content guard synchronous within process, no claimed cross-process transaction.

processes.detail: Streaming shell children with explicit/automatic background task handles; output merged/transformed and lifetime lower layer not fully traced.

code_actions.detail: Shell composes OS programs. Gated REPL/workflow registries exist but core modules unavailable, so persistent code-action engine not established.

persistent_kernel.detail: REPL registry branch and primitives exist but REPLTool core module absent; persistent namespace/lifecycle not established.

standing_database.detail: Inspected state is task/transcript/mailbox data; no model queryable standing research database traced.

workflow_programming.detail: Host query dependencies and hooks, skill/agent tools and notification priorities compose execution; advertised gated WorkflowTool core unavailable.

multi_model.detail: Main/fallback/advisor models and per-peer override in actual model/runner invocation.

live_collaboration.detail: Addressed peer mailboxes and independent persistent peer loops real; idle poll traced, busy delivery incompletely traced, swallowed write failures allow false sent acknowledgement.

concurrent_work.detail: Consecutive declared-safe tools concurrent, independent peer runs and background shell handles; not all effects safe merely by declaration.

steering_interrupt.detail: Provider AbortSignal, post-tool abort terminals and remote interrupt requests; cancellation signal does not prove all program/provider activity settled.

turn_redefinition.detail: Hooks can stop continuation, model deps injectable by host and contexts modified by tools; no traced model-replaceable full scheduling program.

compaction.detail: Multiple projection/micro/auto summary stages, grouping retry truncation and recent-resource restoration; some branches build gated/unavailable.

context_repair.detail: Boundary previous UUID and transcript path support recovery; recent files re-read. No universal model repair operation or preserved transformation originals established.

original_audit.detail: Selective JSONL excludes progress; fallback tombstones partial attempts. Internal best-effort successful response dump is parsed/delta-based, neither all attempts nor original bytes.

audit_query.detail: Rendered text search omits thinking/unknown tool shapes; transcript path accessible but complete original audit unavailable.

hot_change.detail: Config updates some state immediately, query entry snapshots config, tools refresh between model rounds; executable replacement unavailable.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Inspected resume/transcript/remote paths do not establish outpost/refit executable rebuild continuity or quiescence.

remote_services.detail: MCP registry and remote-session authenticated message/permission/interrupt/reconnect client; consumer feature, not governor of shared kernels.

self_improvement.detail: Generic edits/skills/config are present; no independently evaluated executable self-rebuild/promotion program traced.

complaints.detail: Inspected /issue command disabled stub; internal dump comments for /issue not an available universal model complaint/state-table flow.

authority.detail: Model tools subject to configurable permission modes. Even bypass retains certain ask/deny/interaction checks; config write itself asks.

evaluation.detail: Query dependency seam supports fakes; available web session tests target routing/count bookkeeping, not underlying real provider/process cancellation.

time_order.detail: Query UUID chain/depth, 500ms idle poll and wall timestamps provide identities/order hints; pause/restart logical clock semantics unestablished.

evidence.claim: Mirror claims leaked source and preserved backup branch; attribution unverified and current branch modified.
Actual query loop projects/compacts messages before provider step; config snapshot at user-turn entry.
callModel passes tools, abort signal, model/advisor; fallback tombstones orphaned partial messages.
Production model/microcompact/autocompact/UUID dependencies wired.
Consecutive declared-safe calls concurrent with default cap10; unsafe serial; context modifiers reapplied in original block order.
Abort and hook-stop terminal conditions after tool results.
Mid-tool-round agent-addressed prompt/notification drain, deferred slash commands and MCP tool refresh.
Native files/shell/agent/team/task/MCP tools; internal-only config/REPL and gated workflows.
REPL/workflow/context-inspect branches reference gated core modules not available in this tree.
Synchronous stale-read/content check then patch write; same-event-loop atomicity is not cross-process locking.
Shell dispatch with agent-scoped task channel, streaming progress and merged stdout/stderr before result transformation.
Foreground in-place backgrounding and explicit background task handle; assistant timer behind gate.
Addressed and broadcast messages await mailbox API then report sent; writes use wall timestamps.
Locked read/modify/write JSON inbox; read errors become empty list and write errors logged/swallowed, so sent result does not guarantee persistence.
Independent runAgent loop with per-peer model override, retained context, separate work/lifecycle aborts.
Peer remains idle, sends notification and then polls next mailbox/task message; final response not automatically sent to lead.
Idle loop takes pending operator messages and polls file mailbox at 500ms.
Summary retries truncate oldest round groups; errors rejected; recent file/agent/plan attachments restored.
Compact boundary names previous UUID and summary references transcript path.
Transcript excludes ephemeral progress; tombstone rewriting can remove partial messages.
Async queued JSONL append per file; append completion not fsync guarantee.
Internal USER_TYPE-only prompt/response dump, deltas and successful responses, asynchronous best-effort errors ignored.
Rendered transcript search skips thinking, unknown tool shapes and model-only wrappers.
Internal config tool get/set; writes request permission; specific remote-control change updates AppState immediately.
Bypass still respects tool denials, content ask rules, required interactions and path safety checks.
Remote message, permission response, interrupt control request, disconnect/reconnect; client signal is not remote settled-work confirmation.
Acquired issue command is disabled stub.
Mock PTY/WebSocket tests assert session cap, forwarding call counts and cleanup bookkeeping, not true process/IO termination.

tests.oracle: Exact count/cap/cleanup bookkeeping; mocks do not establish real process death or byte preservation.

strengths: Actual peer work-abort versus peer lifecycle-abort separation.
Multiple managed context transformations with boundary/attachment handling.
Concurrency-safe batching preserves input order when applying context modifiers.
limits: Unverified modified artifact must not serve as authoritative official implementation evidence.
Mailbox write failures swallowed before success result; partial attempts/progress not complete audit.
Gated REPL/workflow/issue implementation unavailable or stubbed in acquired source.
arconaut_questions: Make durable message acceptance distinct from recipient observation and turn settlement.
Record failed provider attempts and transformation inputs before changing active transcript.
Specify model-program activation boundaries explicitly; next tool round and settled workflow are different.
